governor-s-shuttle.text: When Played: Each player chooses a unit they control. Defeat those units.

dedra-meero--not-wasting-time.text: Action [1 resource, Exhaust]: Choose an enemy unit. Its controller may deal 2 damage to it. If they don't, draw a card.
dedra-meero--not-wasting-time.epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 4 or more resources, deploy this leader.
dedra-meero--not-wasting-time.deployBox: While you have more cards in hand than an opponent, this unit gains Raid 2. (She gets +2/+0 while attacking.)
dedra-meero--not-wasting-time.rules:
When using Dedra's leader ability, if the chosen unit's controller chooses to deal 2 damage to it, you don't draw a card, even if that damage is prevented.
If there are multiple opponents, the controlling player chooses which one will be “an opponent.”
